owner_authorization.interpreted_scope: Compare every frozen 2026-08-27 YOLO event with the exact positive images and labels used to train the delivered Owner 10k-positive/30k-negative research detector. Recompute the frozen positive-retrieval morphology gate and nearest-reference distance on each mapped prediction core, inspect vertical label semantics, and render paired evidence without inference, threshold tuning, relabeling or training.

audit_contract.current_core: Use the exact mapped integer core from each preserved raw YOLO x prediction; do not move or resize it.
audit_contract.training_spec_match: The mapped core must pass the exact frozen 14-feature morphology gate and have nearest-reference distance <= 0.5, identical to the 10,000-positive retrieval contract.
audit_contract.same_input_alternative: Enumerate all 4/5-bar cores ending 4/5/6 bars before the same model-input endpoint. Report whether any different core in that exact input passes the same frozen training contract.
audit_contract.vertical_semantics: Compare the preserved raw prediction y interval with the six-MA envelope over its mapped core. Separately prove from the generator and 10,000 manifest rows that the training target includes core full wicks plus six MAs and 4% padding.
audit_contract.visual_match: For display only, pair each event with the same-direction training positive having minimum frozen-scale 14-feature RMS distance. This pair is not a Gold label or causal evaluation.

classification.TRAIN_SPEC_MATCH: current mapped core passes gate and distance
classification.LOCALIZATION_MISMATCH: current core fails but another eligible core in the same input passes
classification.OUT_OF_TRAINING_SPEC: no eligible core in the exact input passes

must_disclose: This is the fourth Owner-authorized inspection of the same completed 2026-08-23..27 holdout surface for this detector configuration.
The same-day Top20 universe is post-close and is not a live universe selector.
The audit can prove agreement or disagreement with the frozen training generator; it cannot create per-event Owner Gold boxes.
No model inference, threshold search, relabeling, training, promotion, deployment, forward mutation or order action is performed.
